description: Election Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2020 Procedure for Casting Vote.
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with electoral processes, specifically outlining the procedure for voters to cast their ballots at alternative polling stations due to area conditions. It references the Parliamentary Elections Act, provides application procedures for voters, and is issued by the Commissioner General of Elections. The content focuses entirely on election administration matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized category.
